source.author: lucan
source.text: Molli consurgit Amyclas, Quem dabat alga, toro.
source.text_original: Molli consurgit Amyclas, / Quem dabat alga, toro.
source.text_english: Amyclae rises from its soft couch, which the seaweed furnished.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: molli iuvenes funduntur in alga, conspicuusque toris Tirynthius.
reuse.text_original: molli iuvenes funduntur in alga, / conspicuusque toris Tirynthius.
reuse.text_english: The young men are laid out on soft seaweed, and the Tirynthian is conspicuous on his couch.
